units.source_text: 过了一会儿，那个洋人扭头对自己身旁正弯腰捡东西的日本人说了一两句话，

en.t: After a while, the foreigner turned his head and said a word or two to the Japanese man beside him, who was bending over to pick something up,

units.source_text: 那个日本人捡起掉在沙滩上的毛巾，包在头上，两人就向海边走去。

en.t: and the Japanese man picked up the towel that had fallen on the sand, wrapped it around his head, and the two of them walked toward the sea.

units.source_text: 出于好奇，我一直望着并肩走下海的两个人的背影。

en.t: Out of curiosity, I kept watching the backs of the two men as they walked side by side down into the sea.

units.source_text: 只见他们径直走进海水里，

en.t: I saw them walk straight into the water,

units.source_text: 穿过远处礁石滩周围戏水的人群，走到较为开阔的地方后，

en.t: pass through the crowd playing in the water around the distant rocky shallows, and reach a more open place,
and then the two of them began to swim.

units.source_text: 他们向远处游去，两个脑袋逐渐变小了。

en.t: They swam farther out, and their two heads gradually grew smaller.

units.source_text: 不久，又游了回来，一直游到岸边。

en.t: Before long, they swam back again, all the way to the shore.

units.source_text: 回到茶屋后，也不用井水冲洗，马上擦干身子，穿好衣服，匆匆离去了。

en.t: After returning to the teahouse, they did not even rinse themselves with well water, but immediately dried their bodies, put on their clothes, and hurried away.

units.source_text: 他们走了之后，我仍然坐在长凳上一边抽烟，

en.t: After they had gone, I still sat on the bench smoking,

units.source_text: 一边呆呆地想着先生的事。
我总觉得好像在哪里见过他，

en.t: I kept feeling as though I had seen him somewhere before,

units.source_text: 却怎么也想不起是在什么时候、什么地方见过。

en.t: but no matter how hard I tried, I could not remember when or where it had been.
